closed_entry_filters: Current close > open and > previous_close; the current closed price-breakout event equals 1.
execution: Reuse the unchanged shared Spot long-only next-open engine; stop-first on ambiguous same-bar stop/target.
executor: Laptop2 DESKTOP-F4SA4VL; isolated research lane; Laptop1 stays sole owner Paper writer; failover disabled.
higher_timeframe_filters: Existing completed/asof h4_up=1 and h1_vol_ok=1 only; do not modify their formulas, lag/alignment or thresholds.
identity_deduplication: One price-breakout event per origin/wave-one pivot pair; a later replacement of B does not reactivate an already consumed origin/wave-one pair. This is setup identity de-duplication, not a global strategy trade-count cap.
implementation_choices: 3+3 pivots, 0.382..0.786 retracement, 192-bar origin/span, 32-bar eligible window and completed regime filters are fixed exploratory engineering choices, not mandatory universal Elliott rules or a proprietary indicator replica.
invalidation: All completed lows from O.index+1 through decision t must be strictly greater than O.price. Equality invalidates. A bar that crosses both O and A denies the event.
name: elliott_inspired_wave12_fresh_close_breakout
next_gate: Implement one additive helper/candidate, test causality/invalidation/identity/compatibility on synthetic fixtures, obtain exact-source hosted/native real-exit gates, then freeze and execute one bounded market producer. Do not replay or retune Butterfly.
pivot_rule: Strict alternating low O/high A/low B on closed 15m bars; ties and a simultaneously high-and-low center are rejected. A pivot centered at j is confirmed at close j+3.
post_signal_gap_execution: The shared engine fills at next open under its existing gap/slippage rules. Origin invalidation governs closed setup/decision bars; no strategy-specific next-open origin gate or wave-based stop is added in this hypothesis.
preconfirmation_breakout: No backdated or forced-late entry for a crossing that occurred before the lagged setup was eligible. A distinct fresh later closed re-cross is evaluated by the fixed rule.
proposed_wave_geometry: O < B < A; proposed wave-one size=A-O; proposed wave-two retracement=(A-B)/(A-O).
same_kind_rule: Only a later more-extreme confirmed same-kind pivot replaces the latest future state. Ignore weaker same-kind pivots. Never revise already emitted past output.
shared_backtest_function_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF8 ast.get_source_segment for the backtest FunctionDef; preserve this exact extraction method.

source_references.title: Motive Waves
source_references.used_for: Wave two does not erase all of wave one; wave three progresses beyond wave one. This motivates an early-wave proposal rather than proving a complete count.

source_references.title: Impulse

state_processing_order: At closed decision bar t, expose the setup stored after bar t-1 as lagged context.
Reject an expired setup or one for which any completed low after origin O through t touches or falls below origin price O; this takes priority over a same-bar breakout.

Emit the first fresh close[t] > A with close[t-1] <= A, only for the lagged active setup and within the fixed eligible window. Intrabar high alone never triggers. Record the pivot indices and confirmation index for this event.
Consume the origin/wave-one pair (O.index,A.index) when this price event occurs, even if body/4h/1h gates deny strategy entry. Do not delay an already observed crossing to a later favorable gate.

After processing the current closed-bar event, process a newly confirmed pivot at t for future state. An accepted pivot-state change replaces/disarms the old pending setup; start the latest valid low-high-low candidate only when geometry, historical-low invalidation, span and not-consumed identity pass.
timing: If B is centered at j, its confirmation is j+3; earliest lagged setup decision is close j+4, earliest fill is open j+5. Later eligible breakouts fill no earlier than their next open.
